module_summary: main.c holds the boot globals and main(): early boot (main_boot.c), optional IGR MMCE/cloud backup, then DashRun() which never returns. main_actions.c is the single launch dispatcher ExecuteMainAction (device-path ELF launch, OSDSYS/PS2 disc/DVD player/MISC commands) plus exec cleanup; MainExecuteContext carries boot data to it and to the dashboard. lang.c builds the nine built-in language tables from Lang/*.LNG, parses external LNG files and localises dashboard strings via Lang/DASHBOARD.inc. kelf_signer.c is a self-contained DES/3DES KELF signer used by the exploit installer to bind a user ELF with user-supplied keys. main_console_info.c reads console model, BOOTROM and DVD player version for the info sheets and the installer.

findings.title: Classic MISC screens in ExecuteMainAction are pre-empted by dashRunMisc; config(), Config_Startup/Screen/Network and main_info_screens.c hang off them
findings.problem: Since the classic menu was removed (8155d14), MISC paths reach ExecuteMainAction only via runMiscCommand, and dashRunMisc (dash_main.c:451-494) handles FileBrowser, HddManager, TextEditor, Configure, Exploit_Installer, About, Build_Info, Debug_Info and ShowFont natively first. dashLaunchApp, IGR and remote callers pass ELF/device paths only. So these branches, executeBrowserSelection, isMiscAboutWlePath and their sole callees (config(), Show_About_uLE, Show_build_info, ShowDebugInfo, ShowFont and the classic Config_* screens) are unreachable.
findings.fix: Delete the MISC branches for FileBrowser, HddManager, TextEditor, Configure, ShowFont, Debug_Info, About, Build_Info and Exploit_Installer from ExecuteMainAction, then executeBrowserSelection, getTextEditorReturnPath and isMiscAboutWlePath, main_info_screens.c/.h, config() and Config_Startup/Config_Screen/Config_Network (keep configWriteNetworkSnapshot/configSaveNetworkToPath). With the Exploit_Installer branch gone, exploitInstallerUi is always set by dash_exploit.c, so the NULL/classic paths in main_exploit_installer.c can follow.
findings.benefit: ~1500 source lines (INFERRED from cited ranges). MEASURED in evidence/Launchstation/raw/link/wLaunchELF-contrib-by-object.tsv: main_info_screens.o 5170 B, config_startup.o 4516 B, config_screen.o 4148 B, most of config_network.o 3952 B, plus config()'s share of config.o: >= 15 KB ELF.
findings.evidence: grep ExecuteMainAction src: callers main.c:265 (IGR: Misc_OSDSYS or ELF picked with ext ELF, dash_settings.c:2074), dash_main.c:442 (runMiscCommand, only called from dashRunMisc:494 after the native intercepts at 456-493), dash_main.c:669 (dashLaunchApp; callers pass ELF/library/browser paths: dash_home.c:216-222 and dash_main.c:965-971 route non-ELF launch keys to dashRunMisc; remote path needs ':' dash_main.c:787). grep 'config(' / ShowDebugInfo / Show_About_uLE / Show_build_info / ShowFont( / Config_Startup / Config_Screen / Config_Network over src: only these call chains. Not verified: a hand-edited DASHAPPS.CNF entry holding a MISC path (INFERRED unsupported). Tests assert on source text (test_launch_driver_messages.py, test_project_branding.py mention these names) and need updating.

findings.title: ExecuteBrowserFrom has no caller
findings.problem: ExecuteBrowserFrom is defined and declared but nothing calls it; the dashboard opens the browser with dashOpenBrowser (dash_main.c:497).
findings.fix: Delete the function, its banner comment and its prototype.
findings.benefit: 17 lines removed; -ffunction-sections + --gc-sections already drop it from the ELF (BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:108), so no size change (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep -rn ExecuteBrowserFrom over the whole repo (src include tests scripts docs yaml): main_actions.h:27 (prototype), main_actions.c:874 (comment), main_actions.c:877 (definition). Nothing else.

findings.title: kelf_signer.c host-test scaffolding (KELF_SIGNER_HOST_TEST, KELF_SIGNER_SELFTEST) and kelf_stricmp are unused
findings.problem: No build file, test or script defines KELF_SIGNER_HOST_TEST or KELF_SIGNER_SELFTEST, and no test mentions kelf_signer, so the POSIX shim (lines 1-33) and the main() self-test (1097-1153) are never compiled. kelf_stricmp only exists so the host build works without the PS2 stricmp, which the rest of src uses everywhere.
findings.fix: Delete the #ifdef KELF_SIGNER_HOST_TEST block and its #else/#endif (keep #include "launchelf.h"), delete the KELF_SIGNER_SELFTEST main(), and replace kelf_stricmp with stricmp.
findings.benefit: ~112 source lines removed. The #ifdef blocks are not compiled, so no ELF change; replacing kelf_stricmp saves roughly 100 bytes of .text (INFERRED, kelf_signer.o is 13252 B per wLaunchELF-contrib-by-object.tsv)
findings.evidence: grep KelfSign|KELF_SIGNER|kelf_signer over the whole repo: only ps2.yaml:512, include/kelf_signer.h, main_exploit_installer.c callers, docs. grep -i kelf over tests/: 4 files, none compile kelf_signer.c or define either macro. evidence/Launchstation/cond-macros-undefined.tsv:79-80 lists both macros as defined nowhere. stricmp is used in 20+ src files (cloud_google.c, config.c, dash_*.c).

findings.title: kelf_signer.c 3DES layer: des_cbc_crypt only ever runs one block with a zero IV, key_count 3 is never used, error returns are never checked
findings.problem: tdes_cbc_crypt calls des_cbc_crypt with size 8 and a zero IV for each stage of each block, so the CBC loop inside des_cbc_crypt is unused and subkeys are recomputed every 8 bytes. All 14 callers pass key_count 1 or 2, so the key_count == 3 branches (452-455, 470-473) are dead, and no caller checks the -EINVAL return (all sizes are constant multiples of 8).
findings.fix: Delete des_cbc_crypt; in tdes_cbc_crypt build the one or two subkey schedules once and call des_crypt_block directly per stage; drop the key_count 3 branches and make the function void.
findings.benefit: ~30 source lines removed and fewer des_make_subkeys calls per signing (INFERRED); a few hundred bytes of .text at most (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read every tdes_cbc_crypt call: 820, 822, 823, 920 (key_count 1); 835, 836, 843-846, 864, 898, 921, 1054-1060, 1066-1072 (key_count 2). None tests the return value. des_cbc_crypt is called only from tdes_cbc_crypt (445-471), always with size 8 and tmp_iv zero. Risk Med because it is the signing path; the self-test vector at 1109-1116 can be reused once to check.

findings.title: kelf_signer.c KelfKeyStore duplicates KelfParsedKeys and is filled by a block of memcpy calls
findings.problem: parse_key_store already holds every key in merged.value[KEY_*] with presence flags, then copies each field one by one into a second struct, KelfKeyStore, with the same contents.
findings.fix: Delete KelfKeyStore and pass the merged KelfParsedKeys to the signing helpers, reading value[KEY_SIG_MASTER] etc.; has_override becomes present[KEY_OVERRIDE_KBIT].
findings.benefit: ~25 source lines removed; about 140 bytes less stack per signing call (INFERRED: sizeof KelfKeyStore 8+8+16+8+16+8+8+16+8+8+16+16+4 = 140)
findings.evidence: Read kelf_signer.c:86-107 (both structs), 619-732 (parse_key_store), 734-742 and 981-1095 (only users of KelfKeyStore). KelfKeyStore is file-local; grep KelfKeyStore finds only kelf_signer.c.

findings.title: copy_printable_prefix is copied verbatim into main_exploit_installer.c
findings.problem: The two static copy_printable_prefix functions are identical (21 lines each). main_exploit_installer.c already includes main_console_info.h and uses its GetConsoleModelName.
findings.fix: Make the main_console_info.c copy non-static, declare it in main_console_info.h, and delete the copy in main_exploit_installer.c.
findings.benefit: 20 source lines removed; one copy of the function in the ELF (about 100 bytes, INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read both copies: main_console_info.c:7-27 and main_exploit_installer.c:248-268 are token-identical (dupes-blocks.tsv lead confirmed). grep copy_printable_prefix: only these two definitions and their callers (main_console_info.c:59,164; main_exploit_installer.c:290). main_exploit_installer.c:4 includes main_console_info.h.

findings.title: The 15 MISC command names are listed three times (lang.c rename chain, lang.c rebuild, config.c initConfig)
findings.problem: updateLocalizedMiscPaths has a 15-arm else-if chain pairing each setting->Misc_* field with its LANG id, then 16 sprintf lines building the same fields again; initConfig repeats the 16 sprintf lines with LNG_DEF (and config.c:814 uses LNG instead of LNG_DEF for Build_Info, an inconsistency).
findings.fix: Add one static table of {offsetof(SETTING, Misc_x), LANG_x} and loop over it in all three places (dash_tools.c already addresses these fields by misc_offset). Keep the extra "Exploit Installer" legacy alias as one special case.
findings.justification: The same 15-entry list is written out three times (about 63 lines); one table plus three short loops is about 30 lines, so the change removes code, and a new MISC command then needs one table line instead of three edits.
findings.benefit: ~33 source lines removed net (INFERRED: 63 cited lines -> ~30); some .text from the unrolled sprintf calls (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read lang.c:361-434 and config.c:793-816; launchelf.h:286-300 shows the fields are all char[64]; LNG/LNG_DEF at launchelf.h:682-683 index by LANG_##name so a table of LANG ids works with both Lang_String and Lang_Default. dash_tools.c:1610 already uses (const char *)setting + t->misc_offset.

findings.title: Dead globals and macros in main.c: DiscTypes table, CurrTime, SystemCnf_VMODE, dbgprintf/dbginit_scr
findings.problem: DiscType/DiscTypes and CurrTime have no reference outside their definitions (CurrTime also has an extern); SystemCnf_VMODE is written by scanSystemCnf/readSystemCnf but never read (its own comment says 'As yet unused'); the dbgprintf/dbginit_scr macros are defined in main.c and never used there.
findings.fix: Delete DiscType, DiscTypes, CurrTime (and its extern), SystemCnf_VMODE (definition, extern, the VMODE branch and the reset line in main_startup.c), and the DEBUG macro block in main.c.
findings.benefit: MEASURED in BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:160: DiscTypes 340 B .data and CurrTime 8 B .bss stay in the ELF (no -fdata-sections); SystemCnf_VMODE 10 B .bss (INFERRED); ~45 source lines removed
findings.evidence: grep -rnw over src include tests (c/h/S): DiscTypes only main.c:88,106; DiscType only main.c:82-88; CurrTime only main.c:36 and launchelf.h:652; SystemCnf_VMODE: main.c:69, launchelf.h:374, main_startup.c:159 and 176 (writes only); readSystemCnf's return of scanSystemCnf is ignored (main_startup.c:180-181). dbgprintf/dbginit_scr: no use in main.c (other dbgprintf hits are iop/ps2host with their own definitions).

findings.title: main.c fills the same MainExecuteContext twice (Execute and the DashRun block)
findings.problem: Execute() and main() each set the same ten fields from the same globals, line for line.
findings.fix: Keep one file-scope MainExecuteContext filled once in main() after performEarlyBootInitialization (rough_region and ROMVER_data are set by then), and pass it both to ExecuteMainAction from Execute() and to DashRun.
findings.evidence: Read main.c:250-310; Execute is called only from runWleIgrAfter (main.c:227, 240), which runs after performEarlyBootInitialization (main.c:277); uLE_InitializeRegion fills ROMVER_data/rough_region during boot (main_boot.c:84-85 shows the boot path relies on it). Whether rough_region is always set before line 284 is INFERRED.

findings.title: Set_Language repeats the table copy and MISC path rebuild that Load_External_Language does right after it
findings.problem: Every dashboard caller runs Set_Language then Load_External_Language. Both release the external buffer, memcpy the whole Lang_String table and run updateLocalizedMiscPaths, so each language change does that work twice. The only standalone Set_Language callers are in the classic Config_Startup screen (config_startup.c:113,146), see finding 1.
findings.fix: Reduce Set_Language to storing the normalised language, or have the callers set setting->language and call Load_External_Language only.
findings.benefit: ~5 source lines removed and one redundant table copy plus MISC rename pass per language change (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep Set_Language|Load_External_Language over src: dash_settings.c:1918-1919 and 2561-2562 call both in sequence; config_startup.c:113,146 call Set_Language alone after clearing lang_file; Load_External_Language (lang.c:452-569) with an empty lang_file does exactly what Set_Language does (464-467, 567-568).

findings.title: Small defensive and forwarding leftovers in main_boot.c, main_console_info.c, main_actions.c and main.c
findings.problem: Single-caller code guards against inputs its only caller never passes: captureBootArguments and performEarlyBootInitialization check NULL/0 arguments and keep a local CNF buffer although main.c:276-277 always passes CNF and &CNF_error. get_model_fallback_name only writes "Unknown" and is called right after the model already is "Unknown" (178-179, a no-op); initialize_console_rom1_driver and CleanUpForEmberExec (one caller, ember.c:362) only forward. main_actions.c has 'if (fd < 0)' where fd < 0 is certain (600), a commented label (720) and 'x = x;' (728). wleIgrRequested scans argv twice with a no-op continue.
findings.fix: Delete the unneeded checks and the local CNF fallback; replace get_model_fallback_name and the wrappers with their one-line bodies at the call sites; drop the no-op lines; merge the two argv loops in wleIgrRequested.
findings.benefit: ~30 source lines removed; a MAX_NAME stack buffer gone from performEarlyBootInitialization (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep captureBootArguments: only main.c:276 (passes &boot_argc, boot_argv, 8). performEarlyBootInitialization: only main.c:277 (CNF, sizeof(CNF), &CNF_error). grep CleanUpForEmberExec: main_actions.c:78, launchelf.h:418, ember.c:362. get_model_fallback_name and initialize_console_rom1_driver are static with callers only at main_console_info.c:179,188 and 212. main_actions.c:585-601 read: every path to 600 has fd < 0.
